+@pytest.mark.parametrize('blocked_set', ['_blocked_hosts', '_config_blocked_hosts'])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('blocked_host', ['example.com', 'example.com.'])
+def test_parent_domain_blocking(config_stub, host_blocker_factory, blocked_set,
+                                blocked_host):
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.method = 'hosts'
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = True
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.whitelist = [
+        'https://sub.example.com/allowed'
+    ]
+
+    host_blocker = host_blocker_factory()
+    getattr(host_blocker, blocked_set).add(blocked_host)
+
+    for url in [
+        'https://example.com/',
+        'https://sub.example.com/',
+        'https://a.b.example.com/path',
+        'https://example.com./',
+        'https://a.b.example.com./path',
+    ]:
+        assert host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(url)), url
+
+    assert not host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://sub.example.com/allowed'))
+    assert host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://sub.example.com/denied'))
+    assert not host_blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://notexample.com/'))
+
+
 def test_no_blocklist_update(config_stub, download_stub, host_blocker_factory):
     """Ensure no URL is blocked when no block list exists."""
     config_stub.val.content.blocking.hosts.lists = None
